clinical_diagnosis_summary: Post-ACL reconstruction rehabilitation utilizing a lower extremity kinetic chain approach. The circuit addresses quadriceps strengthening (Tibiofemoral joint) while integrating lateral pelvic stabilization (Coxofemoral joint) to prevent dynamic knee valgus, anchored by lumbar core stabilization to ensure proper force distribution across the axial skeleton.
precautions: Monitor for knee valgus during squats; avoid rapid terminal knee extension; maintain neutral pelvic alignment during hip abduction; ensure pain does not exceed 5/10 during weight-bearing phases.

exercises.protocol_name: P7: Lumbar Spine Flexion / Slip-Disc Rehab
exercises.clinical_rationale: Establishes the axial postural anchor and lumbopelvic stability required to support distal limb movement without compensatory spinal strain.

exercises.protocol_name: P6: Total Hip Replacement Side Abduction
exercises.clinical_rationale: Strengthens the Gluteus Medius as a functional synergist to provide lateral pelvic stability, which is critical for protecting the ACL graft from rotational stress.
Primary agonist protocol for quadriceps hypertrophy and functional restoration of the tibiofemoral joint post-reconstruction.
